text:
Olivia: Quick kickoff for Monday launch assets — small bundle only. Need: hero (1920x1080), square promo (1200x1200), mobile tile (600x900), Twitter card (600x314), plus 3 benchmark micro-cards for social and slide use. Deadline: 36h.
Sam: Noted. Can we lock copy for the cards now? Also prefer PNG exports + one SVG for each icon.
Olivia: Draft headlines: "Serving wins: reduce inference unit costs" (card stat), "Latency at scale" (card metric), "How we measure: tokens + batching" (tiny badge). Keep short.
Priya: Legal flag 020 1: no superlatives like "fastest" unless backed by linked benchmark doc. Also avoid using customer names.
Jamal: Growth want UTMs and a hidden landing param. Use: `?utm_source=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=serving_wins` and hidden input `orig_campaign=serving_wins`.
Sam: Got it. Design Q: prefer imagery style? abstract cloud+GPU iconography, muted gradients, plus one product screenshot inset for hero.
Olivia: Yes to that. Use brand colors but increase contrast on text overlays. Primary hex #0A2F4A, accent #E6B800 (try a warm yellow for callouts). Aim WCAG AA on all card text.
Priya: I'll sign off on copy if comps avoid comparative language. Ping me when first pass is up.
design-bot: Auto-checklist : deliverables list [hero_1920x1080, square_1200x1200, mobile_600x900, twitter_600x314, cardA_stat, cardB_latency, cardC_method, ops_onepager]. Export formats: [png,jpg,svg]. Naming: use dashes `YYYYMMDD-launch-serving-wins-<asset>-v1.ext` (e.g. `20250401-launch-serving-wins-hero-v1.fig`). Contrast report required.
Sam: I'll drop first pass comps in Figma (https://www.figma.com/file/def456/serving-wins-assets) by tomorrow morning. Tagging conv: add `launch:serving-wins` and `audience:webinar` as figma tags.
Olivia: Also include a 2-line alt text for each social image in a comment. Important for accessibility and socials.
Jamal: After assets export, I'll add UTMs and confirm hidden field wires to the SDR queue. Also will need a short CTA line variant for A/B: "Join the webinar" vs "See inference benchmarks".
Sam: Will include both CTA text layers so growth can swap.
Priya: Reminder: speaker headshots must be uploaded to figma frame `speakers/for-legal`. I'll upload mine in a bit.
Olivia: Perfect. If anyone needs copy tweaks, leave them in the figma comments. Thanks team!
Sam: On it 00% — will post comps by 09:00 PT.
